newsitem.title: CHINA: China bus accident kills 25, injures 27.
newsitem.headline: China bus accident kills 25, injures 27.

text.p: An overcrowded bus plunged off a mountain road and into a ravine in central China, killing 25 people and injuring 27, four critically, the Shaanxi Daily reported.
The accident involved a double-decker bus travelling to the Shaanxi provincial capital, Xian. It occurred on March 14, the newspaper said in its March 20 edition, available in Beijing on Sunday.
The bus was carrying 56 people even though it had a capacity of only 27 passengers, the newspaper said.
The accident, in which the bus plunged into a 36-metre (118-foot) ravine, was under investigation, it added.
